biggest_catch: You must route real payroll-style direct deposits — Zelle, Venmo, account transfers, wires, and mobile deposits do NOT count — of $500+ per month for two consecutive calendar months after your opening month, and anyone who has (or ever had) a Wintrust personal checking account is ineligible.
catches: Enter 'Builder' when applying online (or mention the offer in-branch) at account opening — the code is required to activate the bonus.

$300 tier: direct deposits totaling at least $500 each month for the 2 consecutive calendar months after the calendar month the account was opened; $500 tier: at least $2,000 each month. Enroll in online banking and e-statements within the Qualification Period.

Direct deposit means payment by a government agency, employer, or other third-party organization via electronic deposit. It does NOT include teller/ATM/mobile or remote deposits, wire transfers, transfers between Wintrust Financial Corporation accounts, external transfers from other financial institutions, Zelle/Venmo peer-to-peer payments, or debit card transfers/deposits.

Not available to existing or closed personal checking account customers of Wintrust Financial Corporation and its subsidiaries, or Wintrust employees; if you are added as an owner to an older Wintrust checking account before the bonus pays, you become ineligible. Limit 1 bonus payment per customer.
Account must be open with a balance greater than $0 at the end of the Qualification Period to receive the bonus.
Offer valid for eligible accounts opened 5/13/26 - 11/3/26 only (expires November 3, 2026).
Bonus deposited within 30 calendar days after the Qualification Period; bonus subject to IRS 1099-INT reporting and may be considered taxable income.

steps: Open a new Total Access, Access Plus, or Premier Checking account at Wintrust (online, in-branch, or via the promotional URL) between 5/13/26 and 11/3/26, entering 'Builder' when applying online or mentioning the offer in-branch.
Enroll in online banking and activate e-statements within the Qualification Period.

Set up qualifying direct deposits (employer/government/third-party electronic deposits only — not Zelle, Venmo, transfers, wires, or mobile deposits) totaling at least $500/month (for $300) or $2,000/month (for $500) for the 2 consecutive calendar months after the calendar month you opened the account.
Keep the account open with a balance greater than $0 through the end of the Qualification Period; the bonus is deposited into the new account within 30 calendar days after the Qualification Period.
timing: Bonus is deposited into the new account within 30 calendar days after the Qualification Period (the 2 consecutive calendar months after the calendar month the account was opened).
